constraints: @types/refractor only declares types; refractor now ships its own declarations, so no conflicting ambient definition may remain.

steps.instructions: Remove @types/refractor from devDependencies and any explicit reference to it, such as a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.types entry.
steps.title: Remove the stub types package

steps.instructions: Keep refractor on a version that ships its own type definitions and import its types from refractor.
steps.title: Use the bundled declarations

verification.purpose: Type-check and build with refractor's own declarations.
Run the repository tests when defined.

rules.summary: npm marks @types/refractor as deprecated: "This is a stub types definition. refractor provides its own type definitions, so you do not need this installed."
rules.title: @types/refractor is deprecated
